question: What youthful bodily form results from constant yogic practice over time?
premises: Constant practice through yoga is performed
A duration of sixteen years is indicated
The body takes on a corresponding form
inference: Through constant yogic practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa-ākṛtiḥ is taken as the form of sixteen years
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
